items.title: Summer Travel Season May Be Ending, but Marriott’s Stock Is Worth Checking In For

Marriott, along with  Hilton Worldwide Holdings  is one of two major global hotel brands that dominate the industry.  It operates a lucrative asset-light business model, in which franchised properties provide healthy cash flow.
